niche_feature: Safari bushcamp in Kafue National Park offering game drives and predator sightings
category_quote: Nanzhila Lake Camp and Nanzhila Plains Camp are two safari lodges located in the Kafue National Park offering unforgettable predator sightings & personalised hospitality.

amenities.quote: Currently, the 24 hour mammal species count record at Plains Camp is 27 different mammal species across 2 game drives

amenities.text: Boating and fishing on the lake (water levels permitting)
amenities.quote: Occasional boating and fishing on the lake, water levels permitting

highlights.text: Consistent predator sightings, including lion, leopard, cheetah and African wild dog
highlights.quote: guests enjoy consistent and exclusive sightings of lion, leopard, cheetah, and the endangered African wild dog

highlights.text: Wide variety of wildlife and bird species
highlights.quote: Wide variety of wildlife and bird species

highlights.text: Remote wilderness with few other vehicles or guests
highlights.quote: Miles of genuinely remote wilderness, with almost no other vehicles or guests around

access.text: Airport pickup and road transfer to camp (5-6 hours from Lusaka or Livingstone)
access.quote: We will collect you from the airport and drive you to camp.
